reviews.text: All the staff at abbey house kippax are lovely they have been amazing with my old cat very kind and caring professional but friendly… definitely would recommend
Great staff- put my dog at ease after a major operation- unfortunately with all vets prices are through the roof
Caring and knowledgeable vets and staff.  4* rating with RWAF.  I would recommend to any rabbit owner.
Very helpful and friendly staff very good with our pet they explained what they were doing and why,really useful.
Our new puppy George's first visit here all staff were great and helpful.
A very warm welcome for Mabel’s first visit. She was treated like a princess by the lovely staff, and never flinched when she was vaccinated. A very positive visit!😊 …

What should have been a 10-15 min appmt took nearly an hour. Vet was 20 min late in seeing me even though the receptionist reminded her I was waiting. It then took over 10 mins for them to give me medication I originally had requested by fone. I don't feel confident now that they're putting my pet's health before profit. It's a shame as I've been with them for over 16 years with 4 different pets.
I would recommend Abbey House vets, they were very nice and I was seen quickly with my dog. The staff were lovely

The online booking system is flawed
I booked online for 24th may 2025 which is a Saturday
I arrived to find the practice doesn't open Saturdays
I was told to go to another practice 10 miles away but only had 15 minutes to get to the appointment
Not good enough
Lovely staff looked after my two dogs
Great caring service from all the team. Thanks
Friendly and professional staff, always fantastic with our dogs.Abby house is a little bit more expensive than some vets but Worth paying that little bit more for their excellent service and care.
Thank you for how you look after  my old  cat   she was treated  wi her last  breath  and my other cats I had  thakyou for every thing
The staff at Abbey House are very caring and have a wealth of experience. My dog Beth has always had the best of care and treatment. Thank you all.

My cat knows his own mind, and he knows that he DOESN’T like vets. He’s been very roughly treated in the past by other practices - pinned down, scuffed, wrapped in towels like a burrito by nurses and he fought like a bear - he remembers! It wasn’t like that last night at Abbey House Kippax. Yes, he was nervous, he hissed and grumbled but he was spoken to kindly, stroked and cajoled throughout by the lovely vet. I was explained her thought processes throughout, possible diagnoses, meds, tests, etc and when he’d had enough - it was quickly back in the box ‘so we don’t upset him’. A relatively painless procedure. He returns next week. I’d highly recommend Abbey House Kippax.

Abby House Vets have always provided very good services, and the staff are always very friendly and very helpful. I personally think that this veterinary service is very good and reasonably priced. They also have a very good monthly pet plan in place as an extra payment option.
